description: This source file defines a specialized log view adaptor for Orleans' event sourcing system that integrates with a user-provided custom storage interface. It manages reading, writing, and notification processing for log entries, ensuring consistency and handling primary storage interactions within Orleans grains.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2
classes.description: A log view adaptor that utilizes a user-defined storage interface for event sourcing, supporting reading, writing, and notification processing with retry mechanisms.

classes.name: ReadRequest
classes.description: A message class representing a request to read the most recent confirmed log view, containing the known version.

classes.name: ReadResponse`1
classes.description: A message class representing the response to a read request, including the current version and log view state.

classes.name: UpdatePrimaryFailed
classes.description: An exception class indicating failure during primary storage update operations.

classes.name: ReadFromPrimaryFailed
classes.description: An exception class indicating failure when reading from primary storage.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: A message class used to notify other grains of log updates, containing version info and log entries.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the last confirmed log view cached locally.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version number.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Initializes the cached log view to a starting state.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a submission entry for a log entry, with no special tagging.

methods.name: OnMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, serving read responses based on current version and cache.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read from the custom storage, updating local cache and version, with retries on failure.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write of batch updates to the storage, updates local cache and version, with retry and fallback logic.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Processes queued update notifications, applying updates and maintaining version consistency.

methods.name: enter_operation
methods.description: Logs entry into a method (debug only).

methods.name: exit_operation
methods.description: Logs exit from a method (debug only).
